tolerance_policy.rationale: Declared before the native run. Native and this oracle are both float32 and differ only in reduction order, so each normalized 128-dimension token vector must agree closely, and a MaxSim score (a sum of up to 32 cosines, about 30) within 1e-3. The card prints scores to four decimals with unstated hardware, so its anchor uses a looser bound.
